Carpe Noctum

RF calculations and editable routes, on your device.

Tools

Use standalone calculators without naming or saving a route. Inputs and results identify their units and assumptions.

Route & Sweep

  1. Choose Low Split or High Split.
  2. Import a PDF map, review its matched identities and confirm equipment, physical ports and connections. Schedule design levels are not measurement inputs.
  3. Upload the node sweep for the correct physical output port. Confirm Test Point or Direct Connection and the physical offset.
  4. Trace all downstream branches or select amp/EOL destinations. Edit equipment and spans on the map.
  5. Review each active's input, output, unity target, gain shortfall and supported pad/EQ settings. Select one full-sweep trace at a time.
  6. Save or export your new route. Keep an external backup of important routes and original files.

Measurements and estimates

Node values remain blank until measured. Replacement sweeps replace that port's coverage; unavailable frequencies stay blank. Measured output affects its fed branch. Estimates from manufacturer gain/tilt data are labeled; gain feasibility does not establish RF acceptance.

PDF map

Update PDF map creates a copy with active/EOL tombstones beside confirmed symbols. Drag labels in the preview to adjust placement. Retain the original PDF and reselect the exact original after reopening. Repeated exports start from that original.

Optional image tools

Open Tools → Optional image tools to install included Tiny OCR or choose a separate model pack. Image analysis runs on your device and returns suggestions for review. Larger layout and image-description tools are experimental. Downloads fetch public model weights only. APK use requires included packs or local model files; private images are not sent to an AI service. Traditional map recognition remains the default.

New application storage

This fresh build stores new routes separately and does not import historical NightSweep job backups. APK and browser storage are separate. Uninstalling or clearing app/site data can remove routes.
